spans.s:
अब्रह्मचर्य अ-ब्रह्मचर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, un-
chaste.

अब्रह्मण्य अ-ब्रह्मण्य, अम्, n. act not
proper for a Brāhman; an unbrahmanical or sacri-
legious act; in theatrical language an exclamation,
meaning ‘help!’ ‘to the rescue!’ ‘a disgraceful deed
is perpetrated!’

अ-ब्राह्मण्य, अम्, n. violation of sanctity, or of
the duty of a Brāhman.

अ-ब्रह्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. unaccompanied by de-
votion or devotional hymns, wanting in knowledge
or divine wisdom; separated from the Brāhmans.
—अब्रह्म-ता, f., Ved. want of devotion or true
divine knowledge.
—अ-ब्रह्म-विद्, त्, त्, त्, not
knowing Brahma or the supreme spirit.

अ-ब्राह्मण, अस्, m. not a Brāhman; (अस्, आ,
अम्), without Brāhman.

अब्रुवत् अ-ब्रुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, not speak-
ing, silent.

अब्रूकृत अब्रू-कृत, अम्, n. making (अब्रू)
a growling; indistinctness of speech caused by shutting
the lips.
